functional_requirements: Accept four M4 fasteners (clearance diameter 4.2 mm) for through-bolting to a mounting surface.
Flat bottom face MUST sit flush on the mating surface; no protrusions below Z=0.
Bracket MUST be load-bearing in the plate plane (XY) and resist in-plane shear through the fastener holes.
All mounting holes MUST be perpendicular to the plate faces (drilled along the Z axis) so fasteners seat squarely.
Part MUST be producible by 3D printing (FDM) without support material for the through-holes.

Formal semantics: entities are Bracket(plate), Hole(h_i), Diameter(d), Material(m); the script MUST realise the typed specification where Bracket has exactly HOLE_COUNT holes, each Hole has diameter HOLE_DIAMETER and axis parallel to Z, and all holes lie strictly inside the plate boundary.
special_features: All features MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X coordinates mirror about X=0) — hole pair pattern is mirrored left/right.
All features MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y coordinates mirror about Y=0) — hole pair pattern is mirrored front/back.
The four mounting holes MUST be placed at (±HOLE_POS_X, ±HOLE_POS_Y), i.e. X = ±17 and Y = ±12 from the centroid, NOT at arbitrary positions.
Every mounting hole MUST penetrate the FULL plate thickness along the Z axis (Cylinder aligned to Z, height >= PLATE_THICKNESS_Z), forming a through-hole, NOT a blind pocket.
The mounting holes MUST NOT intersect each other or break the plate outer boundary — hole edge must be at least HOLE_INSET_X/HOLE_INSET_Y away from the plate edges.
The bottom face at Z=0 MUST remain a single flat planar face — no chamfers, countersinks or fillets are allowed to cross the Z=0 plane.
The four vertical corner edges of the plate MUST carry a CORNER_FILLET_RADIUS rounded corner, NOT sharp prismatic corners.
Hole count MUST be exactly HOLE_COUNT = 4; adding or omitting a hole violates the formal entity cardinality constraint.

sketches.notes: Rectangular bracket plate profile, centered on the origin (centroid_on_base_plane). Sketch-local X = world X (PLATE_LENGTH_X = 50), sketch-local Y = world Y (PLATE_WIDTH_Y = 40). Extruded +Z by PLATE_THICKNESS_Z = 4 so the solid occupies X=-25..+25, Y=-20..+20, Z=0..4. Symmetric about both the YZ plane (X -> -X) and the XZ plane (Y -> -Y).

steps.label: Extrude flat bracket plate
steps.notes: Base solid: 50 x 40 x 4 plate, Z = 0..4. Bottom face at Z = 0 is the flat datum/mating face. Volume before holes = 50*40*4 = 8000 mm^3.

steps.label: Mounting hole 1 (+X, +Y)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base Z=0..4 (cylindrical height must be >= 4 with overshoot past Z=0 and Z=4). M4 clearance diameter 4.2 mm, axis parallel to Z. Center at (+HOLE_POS_X, +HOLE_POS_Y) = (+17, +12). Hole edge at X=19.1 (inset 8.0 from centerline to plate edge at X=25) and Y=14.1 (inset 8.0 to plate edge at Y=20); strictly inside the plate boundary.

steps.label: Mounting hole 2 (-X, +Y)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base Z=0..4. Mirror of hole 1 about the YZ plane (X = -17, Y = +12). Diameter 4.2 mm, axis parallel to Z.

steps.label: Mounting hole 3 (-X, -Y)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base Z=0..4. Mirror of hole 2 about the XZ plane (X = -17, Y = -12). Diameter 4.2 mm, axis parallel to Z.

steps.label: Mounting hole 4 (+X, -Y)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base Z=0..4. Mirror of hole 1 about the XZ plane (X = +17, Y = -12). Diameter 4.2 mm, axis parallel to Z. Hole cardinality is exactly HOLE_COUNT = 4: {(±17, ±12)} — pairwise separation along X = 34 mm and along Y = 24 mm, both far greater than 4.2 mm, so no hole intersects another.

steps.label: Round the four outer vertical corner edges
steps.notes: FINISHING OPERATION — performed LAST, after every boolean subtraction. Targets only the four external vertical corner edges of the plate at (±25, ±20) running Z = 0..4; edge_selector 'outer' restricts the selection to the external boundary so the internal cylindrical hole seams are NOT filleted. Radius = CORNER_FILLET_RADIUS = 3.0 mm. The fillet surface terminates on the Z = 0 face as an arc and on the Z = 4 face as an arc, so no chamfer/countersink/fillet crosses the Z = 0 plane: the bottom face remains a single flat planar face. Fillet arcs are concave inward (material removed at corners only) so the bounding box stays exactly 50 x 40 x 4 (side faces remain tangent at X = ±25, Y = ±20). Clearance check: fillet arc center (22, 17) R = 3 is 7.07 mm from hole center (17, 12), greater than 3.0 + 2.1 = 5.1 mm, so the corner fillet does not touch any hole.

revision_history.change: Initial design: 50x40x4 flat plate, four M4 clearance through-holes at (+/-17, +/-12) along Z, R3 fillet on the four outer vertical corner edges applied last.

Bracket MUST be load-bearing in the plate plane (XY) and resist in-plane shear through the fastener holes.
All mounting holes MUST be perpendicular to the plate faces (drilled along the Z axis) so fasteners seat squarely.
Part MUST be producible by 3D printing (FDM) without support material for the through-holes.

Formal semantics: entities are Bracket(plate), Hole(h_i), Diameter(d), Material(m); the script MUST realise the typed specification where Bracket has exactly HOLE_COUNT holes, each Hole has diameter HOLE_DIAMETER and axis parallel to Z, and all holes lie strictly inside the plate boundary.
special_features: All features MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X coordinates mirror about X=0) — hole pair pattern is mirrored left/right.
All features MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y coordinates mirror about Y=0) — hole pair pattern is mirrored front/back.
The four mounting holes MUST be placed at (±HOLE_POS_X, ±HOLE_POS_Y), i.e. X = ±17 and Y = ±12 from the centroid, NOT at arbitrary positions.
Every mounting hole MUST penetrate the FULL plate thickness along the Z axis (Cylinder aligned to Z, height >= PLATE_THICKNESS_Z), forming a through-hole, NOT a blind pocket.
The mounting holes MUST NOT intersect each other or break the plate outer boundary — hole edge must be at least HOLE_INSET_X/HOLE_INSET_Y away from the plate edges.
The bottom face at Z=0 MUST remain a single flat planar face — no chamfers, countersinks or fillets are allowed to cross the Z=0 plane.
The four vertical corner edges of the plate MUST carry a CORNER_FILLET_RADIUS rounded corner, NOT sharp prismatic corners.
Hole count MUST be exactly HOLE_COUNT = 4; adding or omitting a hole violates the formal entity cardinality constraint.
